register.source_checks: The issue says this repository's packing-witness verify at 19b354a5, run unmodified on the witness, reports VERIFIED (exact-algebraic, 26796 pairs), and that verifier/sqcheck.py, an exact checker the author's lab wrote separately from this repository's code, reports VALID (exact rational) and now prints the exact side rounded up; it says the two share only the unit-square, wall and non-overlap definitions, and that packing-witness verify is not independent of how the coordinates were rounded, since this repository's packing-witness promote --strategy robust-rational made the exact coordinates from the lab's decimal pose, with pairs separated by at least about 2e-13 and squares at the walls touching them exactly. Before promotion sqcheck.py certified the decimal pose in interval arithmetic at its own side. The witness's claim block says coordinate_provenance: verified. No local-optimality, rigidity or formal check is claimed. Those statements are the author's; no source program ran here.
register.credit: Credit Doğa Özden (https://dogaozden.com/math/live/square-packing/), who reports a packing found from the registry's 232, Francisco Couzo's refinement of Alex Chilton's Kaggle notebook packing (T-256, #844), taken from this repository's regularized known-best atlas, by basin hopping over local minima of Evan Daniel's ALM+SLP quench (evand/square-packing search/packer at bb4cc78e, MIT), compiled into the lab's search, its exact coordinates made by this repository's packing-witness promote. The issue asks that the improvement be credited to Özden, the base packing to its holders as the record lists them, and the local optimizer to Evan Daniel. The search was AI-assisted throughout, the checks were run by code that did not produce the packing, and the issue and repository were prepared and posted by Özden's AI agent, which uses the account kenaznia-doga; Özden directed the work. The best public Kaggle per-puzzle side the issue found at 232, 15.761657946434 (jazivxt), is above this and states no packing.
